tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: App background and the tab bar ground. Text on it: ink, ink-muted. Never behind cover art as an overlay.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Flat cards: spotlight card, session blocks, match card, list groups, unselected chips. Text on it: ink, ink-muted, accent-text.

tokens.name: surface-quiet
tokens.usage: Quiet fills: pill buttons, +1 button, done and paused badges, switch track. Text on it: ink only (ink-muted is below 4.5:1 here).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text, selected chip fill, filled stars, focus ring. Reads on bg, surface and surface-quiet in both themes.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, inactive tab labels. Reads on bg and surface (4.6:1 and up). Do not use on surface-quiet.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines and dividers. Decorative only; never the sole border of a control.

tokens.name: border-control
tokens.usage: Borders of controls and the dashed free slot: ghost button, search field, switch, outline badge. At least 3:1 on bg and surface.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one accent, coral. Only for actions (primary button, plus button, switch on), progress bars and counts. Fill color only; for text use accent-text.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons placed on an accent fill. 5.5:1 in light, 6.8:1 in dark. White on coral is only 3.1:1, so never use white.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Coral as text: counts like 5/5, the Fill link, 4/6h in the goal pill. 5.1:1 on bg and surface in light, 5.8:1 in dark.

tokens.name: track
tokens.usage: Empty part of a progress bar. 2.4:1 against coral in light, so the number is always also written next to the bar.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring, 2px solid with a 2px offset. Visible on bg, surface and surface-quiet.

tokens.name: cat-movie
tokens.usage: Movies: teal. Tag dot and timeline edge only. 3.7:1 on bg in light.

tokens.name: cat-series
tokens.usage: Series: blue. Tag dot and timeline edge only.

tokens.name: cat-anime
tokens.usage: Anime: pink. Tag dot and timeline edge only.

tokens.name: cat-manga
tokens.usage: Manga: moss green. Tag dot and timeline edge only.

tokens.name: cat-book
tokens.usage: Books: amber. Tag dot and timeline edge only.

tokens.name: cat-game
tokens.usage: Games: purple. Tag dot and timeline edge only.

tokens.name: cat-movie-soft
tokens.usage: Tag background for movies. Text on it: ink (14:1 in light, 10:1 in dark).

tokens.name: cat-series-soft
tokens.usage: Tag background for series. Text on it: ink.

tokens.name: cat-anime-soft
tokens.usage: Tag background for anime. Text on it: ink.

tokens.name: cat-manga-soft
tokens.usage: Tag background for manga. Text on it: ink.

tokens.name: cat-book-soft
tokens.usage: Tag background for books. Text on it: ink.

tokens.name: cat-game-soft
tokens.usage: Tag background for games. Text on it: ink.

tokens.name: avatar-1
tokens.usage: Initials avatar fill, sand. Initials in ink.

tokens.name: avatar-2
tokens.usage: Initials avatar fill, sage. Initials in ink.

tokens.name: avatar-3
tokens.usage: Initials avatar fill, dusk. Initials in ink.

tokens.name: avatar-4
tokens.usage: Initials avatar fill, rose. Initials in ink.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Rare. Empty states and onboarding only.

styles.name: screen-title
styles.usage: One per screen: Tonight, Plan, Library, item titles.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Numerals and short headings such as 87% and a time option.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default text and row titles (at weight 700).

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Section labels, set in uppercase: CONTINUE, YOU ALL WANT.

styles.name: tab
styles.usage: Tab bar labels. 11px is the smallest size in the system.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label, tight gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gaps between chips, tiles and buttons.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between rows and between the 2 to 3 sections of a screen.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Screen gutter and card padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Large button side padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between sections when a screen has room.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Top of a screen below the status bar.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Empty-state spacing.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Thumbnails in list rows.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Cover art everywhere. Covers are never rounder than this.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, session blocks, time options.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Spotlight card, match card, grouped lists.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Sheets and the cover blocks of this system.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Chips, pill buttons, badges, tags, progress bars, switch.

tokens.name: size-tap
tokens.usage: Minimum touch target for every control.

tokens.name: size-tabbar
tokens.usage: Tab bar height, before the bottom safe area.

tokens.name: size-progress
tokens.usage: Thin progress bar under cover tiles.

tokens.name: size-progress-lg
tokens.usage: Progress bar on item detail.

tokens.name: size-hour
tokens.usage: Timeline height of one hour.

tokens.name: size-avatar
tokens.usage: Default avatar diameter. Small is 24px, large is 44px.

tokens.name: size-tile
tokens.usage: Default cover tile width. Covers are 2:3.
